user.title: Connect to Realiser A16
user.description: Enable the TCP command server on the A16 (Settings > Network) and enter its fixed IP address and TCP command port.

data_description.host: Fixed IP address configured on the A16.
data_description.port: TCP command port configured on the A16 (default 4101).

reconfigure.title: Change connection
reconfigure.description: Change the IP address or TCP command port of the A16. A new IP address is tested; it must belong to the same A16. The integration reloads after saving.

data_description.host: Fixed IP address configured on the A16.
data_description.port: TCP command port configured on the A16 (default 4101).

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect. Check the IP address, the port and that the TCP command server is enabled. The A16 accepts only one controller at a time: close other control apps (e.g. Centro Control) and try again. After closing another app or restarting, the A16 may refuse new connections for about a minute.

abort.wrong_device: A different A16 answers at this address. To add it, set it up as a new device.

not_reachable.message: Cannot connect to the Realiser A16 at {host}. Another control app may hold the only connection the A16 accepts. After closing another app or restarting, the A16 may refuse new connections for about a minute.

command_failed.message: The Realiser A16 did not execute the command: {error}

mute_failed.message: The Realiser A16 did not confirm the mute state.
